text_block_list.text:
I beat you, you beat me not! I beat you,
you beat
me not!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I BEAT YOU! Hah! How do ya like that? I
won!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I can't believe I lost to a weirdo like you! Ughhh, this sucks.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Oh? You mad, bro? Wanna go again?
'Cause I'm
down.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: You are literally the worst! This is not over!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna take you on in one
of those
big races, and you're gonna be
toast.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Oho! One of the big 'uns, huh? Sure,
you're on!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like it'll be long before
Голд Шип
and Тосэн Джордан face off
again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Like I know. Someone just told me to
give it to
you. Later.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Well then, let's have a look-see.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The paper Flash gave me had "UM," and
now I've
got "QUA." It's all clear now...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Clear that I've got no clue what this
means, that
is!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The meaning of the hints might not be
clear, but
there is something that is.
Since both Эйсин Флэш
and Tosen
Jordan had a clue...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It must mean someone is orchestrating
this and
giving them the information.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Who's the mastermind behind this
"Eden" Gold
Ship is pursuing, and what
is their agenda? I can't
help but be
intrigued.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
